name: Karma Triyana Dharmachakra
technique: Vajrayana meditation, puja/ritual practice, and self-directed personal retreat under lama guidance
teacherAccess: Resident lamas and monastic teachers lead weekly teachings and pujas; personal retreat purpose and practice plan is reviewed and approved by the lamas beforehand.
retreatOptions: Day visits and weekend teachings up to week-long teaching/nyungne retreats, plus open-length, self-directed Personal Retreat stays (multi-night minimum, scheduled by application).
about: Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (KTD) is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery in the Catskill Mountains above Woodstock, NY, founded in 1976 by the 16th Karmapa as the North American seat of the Karma Kagyu lineage. It functions as a working monastery with a resident monastic community, holding daily pujas and offering weekly public teachings, periodic week-long retreats, and nyungne retreats throughout the year. KTD also runs a Personal Retreat program allowing individual practitioners to stay on-site in private, shared, or dorm rooms for self-directed practice, with dates and purpose approved in advance by the resident lamas. Guests take meals with the community and can join the daily schedule of shrine room practice.
schedule: Weekly public teachings and thrice-daily pujas year-round, periodic week-long and nyungne retreats tied to the ritual calendar, plus Personal Retreats scheduled individually by application (minimum one week advance notice).
cost: Personal Retreat lodging is priced per night by room type (dorm, shared, or private); other public teachings and pujas are generally offered on a dana (donation) basis.

pricePerDay.notes: From the Personal Retreat Application room-rate options: Dorm $48/night, Share with Friend $62/person/night, Private $96/night.

foodNotes: Vegetarian meals (with vegan options) are provided to guests and retreatants; meals require preregistration.
workNotes: No work-practice requirement for guests is specified on the official site; retreatants join the monastery's existing daily schedule.
